exposure: single euploid blastocyst transfer in a medicated frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycle
transfer of an untested blastocyst in a natural FET cycle
outcome: monochorionic diamniotic twins and a singleton
cohort: Two women, aged 29 and 34, who underwent single blastocyst embryo transfer (sBET) for assisted reproductive technology (ART).
finding: Monzygotic (MZ) triplet pregnancies are an exceptionally rare but possible complication following single blastocyst embryo transfer (sBET), highlighting that sBET does not entirely eliminate the risk of multiple pregnancies.
